description:
Expand live cloud benchmark execution across BigQuery, Databricks, and Snowflake to Primitives and Time Series suites, plus Vector Search where a platform variant exists:
- Read Primitives: 157 read pattern queries (SF 0.01, 0.1; the registry caps this benchmark at 0.1)
- Write Primitives: 112 write/update/delete operations (SF 0.01, 0.1, 1.0)
- Transaction Primitives: 23 transaction queries (SF 0.01, 0.1, 1.0)
- Metadata: 62 schema and catalog inspection queries (SF 1.0)
- TSBS DevOps: 18 time-series aggregation queries (SF 0.1, 1.0, 10.0)
- Vector Search: 6 vector similarity and ANN search queries (SF 0.1, 1.0, 10.0) on Snowflake and Databricks; BigQuery has no vector_search query variant

AI Primitives (16 queries) is out of scope: it was deferred on 2026-09-22 and is not part of the corpus campaign.

Execute across BigQuery, Databricks, and Snowflake at the supported scale factors.
Verify that no operation FAILS, that skipped operations match the benchmark's recorded platform capability gaps, and that bundles validate cleanly.
